official_formulas.suite_and_pooled_wilson_margin: Wilson95(k,n) = larger distance from k/n to either 95% Wilson interval endpoint; reported in percentage points.
official_formulas.pooled_overall: p_pool = total successes across all included suite episodes / total included suite episodes.
official_formulas.equal_weight_suite_mean: mean = (p_robolab + p_simplerenv + p_robotarena) / 3. Only emitted when all three suites are present.
official_formulas.equal_weight_suite_mean_margin: SE = sqrt(sum(p_s*(1-p_s)/n_s for each suite)) / 3; reported mean margin in percentage points = 196*SE.
official_formulas.subgoal_progress: progress_s = sum(subgoals_done) / sum(subgoals) within each suite; overall progress mean is unweighted mean over the three suite progress values.

hard_rules: Official episode rows use exactly the seven fields in official_episode_fields; no additional properties.
Episode success is derived from the official episode log, never manually supplied or inferred from a Symtropy receipt.
subgoals_done follows the official goal_objects/goal_trace algorithm and task-catalog order for Relay/Revisit.
Do not alter official task success definition.
Do not combine LADDER-Lite and full benchmark results.
Do not combine privileged and non-privileged scores.
Do not omit failed episodes or select best reruns.
Full-benchmark claims require all tasks in all three suites with default episode counts; partial-suite entries must be labeled as partial suite coverage.
Set tuned_on_ladder=true when system components, prompts, thresholds or settings were trained or tuned on benchmark tasks/scenes.
Physical robot runs and simulator runs are reported separately.
Symtropy evidence, energy, thermal, recovery and cost metrics belong in a sidecar and never substitute for or modify the official episode row.
